phishvn_v4.known_limit: URLs are scheme-stripped; do not infer HTTP/HTTPS behavior or use is_https.

phishtank.minimum_label_evidence: verified=yes plus verification_time and source phish_id
phishtank.terms_gate: record the applicable terms snapshot and retrieval time

openphish.access_gate: approved academic access; do not redistribute contrary to terms

ror.minimum_label_evidence: page-level provenance, successful static capture metadata, no redirect to unverified host, no overlap with phishing feeds at collection; otherwise uncertain
